comment: Furiah's Visuals: the animation set of one-handed swords held upright at the right (the Photon Edge and the other sabers). Swings run in vanilla's swing time; t is 0..1 of each clip. right: the fist in view space (offset in blocks, turns in degrees about the fist: pitch up, yaw left, roll counter-clockwise), or an exact place and direction ({pos, tip, edge}). Every clip here is original to this mod.

saber_swing_1.comment: A fast diagonal slash from high on the right down to the lower left.

saber_swing_2.comment: A flat slash from right to left, the blade laid forward.

saber_swing_3.comment: A rising backhand slash from the lower left up to the right.

saber_quick_swing_1.comment: Rapid clicks: a short cut down to the left.

saber_quick_swing_2.comment: Rapid clicks: a short cut back up to the right.

saber_crit.comment: A critical hit: a lunging thrust, the point driven at the target.

saber_guard.comment: Blocking: the blade held level across the view, its edge up toward the blow.

saber_dual_guard.comment: Blocking with a saber in each hand: the blades crossed in an X (the left hand's is this, mirrored).

saber_draw.comment: The draw: up from the hip in one sweep, into the ready hold.
